description: Each rounding mode on ties, near-ties, and exact values, in the order HalfEven HalfUp Down Up Floor Ceiling.
program:
(let [d (fn [s] (match (decimal.parse s) (some x) x none (decimal.from-int 0)))
      modes [HalfEven HalfUp Down Up Floor Ceiling]
      row (fn [s places] (map (fn [m] (decimal.show (decimal.round (d s) places m))) modes))]
  [(row "2.5" 0) (row "-2.5" 0) (row "3.5" 0) (row "0.125" 2) (row "-0.125" 2) (row "2.51" 1) (row "-2.49" 0) (row "7" 2)])
